integrity: The four-history likelihood is explicit; analytical arguments cover the continuum. A standalone verifier checked the symbolic information entries, exact finite-budget counterexample, and 1214 individual finite computations.
limitations: Closed, homogeneous two-visit binary survey experiment and local joint Fisher D-optimality only; not a field-calibrated survey protocol. Finite-budget global bifurcation uniqueness and historical priority are not claimed.
title: A two-visit occupancy experiment breaks equal-effort optimality
